title: SQL FCI status: active/passive WSFC nodes
description: The nexus-cli status verb for the SQL Server FCI: which WSFC node owns the SQL Server cluster role, and does the FCI virtual server answer as the operator.

observe.what: one node fci-active/online, the other fci-passive/standby; leader = the active owner of the SQL Server (MSSQLSERVER) cluster group

whatProves: the FCI presents a single active SQL instance over a 2-node WSFC; status reads the cluster group owner + an operator round-trip to the FCI virtual server sqlfci.
